verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. A song. God, praise waits for you in Zion. We will keep our promises to you.
You hear prayer. All people will come to you.
When our sins were too much for us, you forgave our wrongdoing.
Happy is the one you choose and bring near to live in your courtyards. We are filled with the good things of your house, your holy temple.
You answer us with amazing acts of goodness, God our saviour. You are the hope of everyone to the ends of the earth and of those far away across the seas.
With your power you formed the mountains. You are dressed in strength.
You calm the roaring seas and their crashing waves, and the uproar of the nations.
Those who live far away are amazed at your wonders. Where the morning dawns and where the evening fades, you make people shout for joy.
You take care of the land and water it. You make it very rich. God's streams are full of water. You give people grain, because that is how you planned it.
You soak its ploughed rows and flatten its ridges. You soften it with showers and bless its crops.
You crown the year with your goodness. Your wagons overflow with plenty.
The grasslands of the wilderness overflow. The hills are dressed with joy.
The fields are covered with flocks. The valleys are clothed with grain. They shout for joy and sing!
